title: Aureline M5 review template packet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a review-template packet. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the comment / summary template, the template version, the review-pack version and digest it is bound to, and the preserved-on-export guarantee that keeps the template attribution through export, publish, and reopen — so review-pack version / digest and template attribution are never lost. Downstream review detail, the review-pack summary, support / export packets, and help / docs point at this schema instead of restating a template by hand. Secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
